_about: Maps a filed role title to a role level. Rules run in order on the lower-cased title; the first match wins. The result is a Derived field: it comes from the filed title by these rules, not from the filing itself.

rules.why: CEO of a business unit, not of the company
C-suite title (Chief ... Officer) or an executive whole-time director

rules.pattern: business head|^president\b|joint president|executive director \(|division\b|country business leader
rules.why: Leads a business, region or division
Leads a function (HR, finance, supply chain, legal, sales and so on)
Any other named Senior Management Personnel
